title: Verification Result
description: Evidence bundle file .agent/runs/<TASK-ID>/verification/result.json, produced by the independent verifier (spec F.7, Appendix B). A PASS without attached evidence is treated as FAIL by gates (F.7 On underdelivery).

task.description: Task id this verification run belongs to. null when the verifier was not given one (spec Appendix B example; the shipped .agent/verification/lib/evidence.mjs writes `task ?? null`).

commit.description: Commit hash of the verified candidate. null when the verified tree is not a git repository (the shipped .agent/verification/lib/evidence.mjs writes `commit ?? null`).

checks.description: One deterministic PASS/FAIL per line of the task's verification: block (spec §6.1, F.7 Done means).

status.description: Per §9.5 every verifier failure is additionally classified as PRODUCT FAILURE, ENVIRONMENT FAILURE, or FLAKE before entering the learning loop; that classification may be recorded here (see `classification`) as well as in the retrospective.

evidence.description: Path (relative to this run's verification/ directory, e.g. .agent/runs/<TASK-ID>/verification/) to the evidence artifact for this check, e.g. api.json or logs/db.log.

classification.description: Spec §9.5 flake policy: a FAIL is written UNCLASSIFIED by the verification harness (.agent/verification/lib/checks.mjs runCheckWithRetry, retry-once-then-quarantine) and reclassified by a human/verifier before it enters the learning loop.

note.description: Free-text context for the human/verifier, e.g. retry history across the two flake-policy attempts (spec §9.5).

error.description: Error detail for a FAIL check, e.g. an assertion message or stack trace excerpt.

environment.description: Description of the isolated verification environment, e.g. ephemeral-postgres-14 (spec F.7).

reproducible_with.description: Path to the reproduction command/script, e.g. .agent/verification/api/run.sh (spec F.7).
